name: El Mohán
description: El Mohán is a Colombian folk figure — a hairy, long-bearded river spirit and shamanic ancestor associated with the Magdalena River and the rivers of Tolima and Huila — said to seduce young women, harass fishermen, and guard hidden treasures.

aliases.name: Mohanes
aliases.region: Colombia and parts of South and Central America

origin: Strongest in the Magdalena River basin and the central Andean Colombian departments of Tolima and Huila. Variants of the figure (Muan, Moan, Poira, Mohanes) appear across Colombia and into other parts of South and Central America.
